text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(They were only trying their very best to help the investigation. 
But all I did was scold them…)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Remembering their expressions yesterday… 
They felt hurt. That much is clear.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(First, I need to apologize. Then I need to change my approach. 
If I want this mission to succeed, I need to meet them where 
they're at.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! 
I deeply apologize for my shameful conduct yesterday!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
To think I spoke to you all in such an oppressive manner… 
I swear from the bottom of my heart, I have reflected on 
my actions!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
From now on, I want to use an investigation style that works 
for all of you! Would you be willing to teach me what that style 
would be?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
W-what!? I mean, part of that was our fault, so… 
Uhh…… W-what should we——

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Hmm… Our style, huh… 
How's this? Let's all go hang out! And you're coming with us, 
Fenomeno-chan!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Let's play VR Battle Brawl! I've been really into it lately! 
Windy-senpai, Urara-senpai, you've played before, right?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Interesting. I am very much new at this… 
But I'll try my best not to get in the way!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Battle Brawl is a 5-on-5 online war game. 
Since it's a team game, even beginners can play just fine!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All we have to do is bring the enemy's health to zero! It's simple! 
You ready, guys? Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so this is my weapo—— 
Wait, I thought I picked a police baton!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Eyes on the fight! 
The enemy's charging at us! Let's get 'em!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Leave them to me! Ha!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: PEGASUS MACH STRIKE!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, nice finisher! That was sick, Biko-chan! 
And that pose you hit at the end? 
That was just like Carrotman!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You got it! 
Hehe, I've spent sooo much time practicing her special pose!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Oh, so some of the animations change your outfits! I want to tr—— WAGH!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
……T-they took me out in an instant… 
Rgh! If only I could have contributed to the fight!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno-senpai—— Whoa! 
Oh, no, they're coming at me two-against-one! 
This is bad…!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
They're ganging up on me too! Dang it, they're good at this! 
They're not giving us a chance to strike back!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Urgh… If this keeps up, eventually they're gonna take us out…!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Stay strong just a little longer, guys! It's just a little chip 
damage! You're blocking like champs! They're not gonna 
be able to keep it up forever!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Duh! 
No way am I gonna let them keep beating up on me!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Biko-chan, I'm here to help! HIYAH! …H-hiyaaaahhhhhh!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Now! Hahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Nice assist, Urara-chan! You get the championship belt 
for the nicest teammate ever! We're working together like 
a well-oiled machine! Let's keep up the teamwork and beat 'em!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Amazing…! The numbers disadvantage hasn't shaken them 
in the slightest! If anything, they're even more determined now!)

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you're really good at dodging, Windy-chan! 
Look how confused you're making them! They can't keep up!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Muahaha, tricked you, dummy! 
Hope you're ready for the finishing bite!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: CHOMP!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Brilliant moves, Windy-san! 
And Big-san's callouts are just as sharp!)

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
You got 'em! Nice going, Windy-chan! 
Looks like Big-san's gotta show her stuff, too!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Me too! 
I'm not done yet! 
Hiyaaaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Biko-san's even more ready to fight…! 
I see, so Big-san's calling out to raise their morale!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(But she's doing much more than simply cheering them on. 
She's paying close attention and playing on their strengths…!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Her encouragement resonates with them because she 
understands them well. That's why her praise can 
draw out the fire inside them!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(……It all makes sense. It's the exact opposite of what I did 
yesterday. She's accepting who they are, teaching them what 
makes them great… That's what matters!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Excellent diversion, Windy-san! The other team is full of 
openings now! Urara-san, your unpredictable moves are 
working on them! Keep on wreaking havoc!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ……! Okaayyyy, I'm gonna keep doing good!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Biko-san! Your consistency and power are extraordinary! 
Your fist of justice is the foundation for the team's victory!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huff… huff… Hehe, that's right… 'Cuz I'm a superhero!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Huff, huff… Just one more push…! 
It's time for Big-san to show what she's made of…!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I believe in you, Big-san! I know you won't give up! 
There's no one else as persistent as you!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Even when you were put up against the wall, 
you never gave up on victory! 
The team only made it this far thanks to your encouragement!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Victory is right in front of you! 
Reach out and take it, Big-san!!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: Okay! I promise I'm not gonna let this big chance go!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: BIG SUPER BIG BANG!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
You did it…! 
I knew the bitter end would be your time to shine, Big-san!!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! Looks like I made it big!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: That was so much fun! And we even beat a really tough team! And your finisher was super cool, Big-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I couldn't have done it without you guys cheering for me! 
You got me so fired up! Especially you, Fenomeno-chan! 
I could really feel the hype!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Well, your incredible exploits really did deserve that much 
praise. Biko-san, you brought the team together like a true 
superhero. Urara-san, you fought with everything you had——

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Windy-san, you took the lead with your sharp mind. 
And Big-san, you raised the team's spirits with your praise. 
Each of your strengths shone through today.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
You are all amazing Umamusume, each with your own 
irreplaceable strengths. I've always believed you were, from the 
moment I recruited you!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: That's why… I'd like to ask you all, one more time.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I promise to carry out this investigation in a way that works for 
you all! So please, would you be willing to join me in it!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
…You really feel that way about us?… 
Well, don't worry! None of us would ever quit the investigation!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh! Oh well. You're no good without an awesome team like us, Captain, so I guess you can count on us!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thank you! I know I'm far from a perfect captain, so I'll 
need all of your help. I look forward to seeing all of you 
tomorrow!
